description: Reliance Jio has launched a new recharge plan in India that gives users access to more than 1,000 live TV channels via the JioTV app. This new plan offers 30 days of validity and is available for both prepaid and postpaid Jio customers. It is priced at  Rs. 55. Jio confirms that it includes access to more than 150 premium channels.
title: Jio Launches Rs. 55 JioTV Pro Pack in India With Access to Over 1,000 Live TV Channels

description: Realme has teased the launch of the Narzo 100x 5G in India through an official microsite. The teaser reveals part of the handset's rear design and carries the tagline "Non-Stop Power, Loading Soon!", hinting at a possible focus on battery life. While specifications and the launch date remain under wraps, the smartphone is expected to join the recently launched Realme Narzo 100 Lite 5G in the company's lineup. More details are expected to be announced in the coming days.
title: Realme Narzo 100x 5G India Debut Confirmed, New Listing Appears on Realme's Website

description: Huawei's MatePad Pro Max was launched in May in global markets this year with a 13.2-inch flexible OLED display. Now the company seems to be working on a new version of this tablet with a smaller screen, codenamed Dali. It could offer a portable design similar to the iPad Pro. However, details regarding its specifications, pricing, and official launch timeline are scarce. The Huawei MatePad Pro Max came with up to a 10,400mAh battery and 66W fast charging support.
title: Huawei Working on Smaller Version of Flagship MatePad Pro Max Tablet, Tipster Claims

description: Nubia will launch the "world's first mass-produced AI-powered smartphone" soon, Nubia’s President Ni Fei announced on Wednesday in a post on Weibo. The handset will be unveiled during the World Artificial Intelligence Conference 2026. The event is scheduled to begin on July 17 and will conclude on July 20, and will take place in Shanghai. However, the Nubia President did not confirm the name of the upcoming AI-powered handset. Tipster Whylab claims in a post on the Chinese microblogging platform that the upcoming Nubia handset could be the successor to the Nubia M153.
title: Nubia to Launch New AI-Powered Smartphone at World Artificial Intelligence Conference 2026

description: Noise has launched the REP Band in India as its first screenless wearable. The health-focused band offers subscription-free access to continuous biometric tracking and AI-backed health insights through the NoiseFit app. It features a stainless steel body, 10-day battery life, 5ATM water resistance and automatic workout detection. The wearable supports heart rate, HRV, SpO2, sleep, stress and recovery tracking. The Noise REP Band is available at a special introductory price of Rs. 9,999, with pre-bookings now open.
title: Noise REP Band Launched in India With Screenless Design, Up to 10 Days Battery: Price, Features

description: Vivo appears to be readying the Vivo X500 series. As we wait for the official launch, a leak has detailed the key specifications of a phone which is believed to be either the X500 Pro Mini or the Vivo X500 Pro. It is expected to come with the Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset. The phone is likely to have a battery capacity of around 7,000mAh. It is said to feature a 64-megapixel 85mm periscope telephoto camera and a large LOFIC primary sensor.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Mini Leak Reveals 2nm MediaTek Dimensity Chip, 7,000mAh Battery and More

description: Samsung Galaxy M67 spotted on Geekbench website with model number SM-M676K. It is listed with an octa-core Samsung Exynos 2200 chipset clocked at 2.80GHz. The listing shows the phone with Android 17 and 8GB RAM. The Samsung Galaxy M67 posted a single-core score of 1,435 and a multi-core score of 3,744.
title: Samsung Galaxy M67 Pops Up on Geekbench With Exynos Chip, Android 17

description: The market capitalisation of MiCA-compliant euro stablecoins surged 128 percent in the year leading up to the European Union's July 1 MiCA deadline, according to a report by Decta. The study also found a 43.1 percent increase in trading volume and a rise in the number of compliant euro stablecoins from five to eight. Despite the growth, euro-denominated stablecoins remain a small fraction of the much larger US dollar-backed stablecoin market.
title: MiCA-Compliant Euro Stablecoins' Market Cap Grew By 128 Percent Ahead of EU Deadline: Report

description: Samsung Galaxy A18 has been spotted in leaked computer-aided design (CAD) renders, revealing the handset's design and key specifications. The Galaxy A18 is shown to feature a pill-shaped rear camera module, similar to its predecessor. However, there is a subtle difference between the camera islands of the two. While Galaxy A17 5G’s deco is finished in black, the one found on the Samsung Galaxy A18 appears to sport the colour of the body instead. Other design features appear to be identical between the two smartphones. The Samsung Galaxy A18 is shown to sport a flat rear panel, with an LED flash placed in the top-left corner, next to the camera module.
title: Samsung Galaxy A18 Appears in Leaked CAD Renders That Suggest It Will Resemble Its Predecessor From the Front

description: Meta has launched Muse Image, its first image generation model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, across Meta AI, Instagram and WhatsApp. The model allows users to generate AI images using public Instagram photos by tagging public accounts in prompts, although users can opt out through Instagram settings. Muse Image also supports conversational image editing, multiple photo blending, preset styles, room redesigns and AI-powered markup editing. Meta said Facebook, Messenger and Advantage+ integration will arrive later, while Muse Video remains in development.
title: Meta's Muse Image Uses Content From Public Instagram Accounts for AI-Generated Images

description: Nothing Phone (4b) was released in India earlier this year with a starting price tag of Rs. 34,999. It runs on a Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 chipset and carries a 6,000mAh battery. The new phone competes with the likes of the Samsung Galaxy A37 5G and the Realme 16 in India. Here's a quick comparison of the Nothing Phone (4b), Samsung Galaxy A37 5G, and Realme 16 based on their price in India and specifications.
title: Nothing Phone (4b) vs Samsung Galaxy A37 5G vs Realme 16: Price in India, Specifications Compared

description: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked 2026 is scheduled for later this month. Ahead of the bi-annual hardware launch event, the South Korean tech conglomerate has begun pre-reservations for its next-generation Galaxy foldable smartphones and smartwatches in India. While the company did not name the handsets, the rumour mill suggests Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, Galaxy Z Fold 8, and Galaxy Z Flip 8 could be announced.
title: Samsung Begins Pre-Reservations for Upcoming Galaxy Z Foldables in India

description: Moto G77 Power has been launched in India. The smartphone is scheduled to go on sale in India on July 13 via Flipkart and the Motorola India online store. The Moto G77 Power is offered in Pantone Fuchsia Red, Pantone Impenetrable, and Pantone Nautical Blue colour options. The new handset is powered by a 6nm octa core MediaTek Dimensity 6400 chipset. For optics, the Moto G77 Power carries a dual rear camera system, headlined by a 50-megapixel (f/1.8) primary shooter. It packs a 7,000mAh battery that is claimed to provide up to 59 hours of battery life.
title: Moto G77 Power Launched in India With 7,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: WhatsApp announced the rollout of Meta Business Agent in India at the third edition of Meta's annual Business Summit in Mumbai on Wednesday. According to Meta, it is an AI-powered solution to help businesses automate customer interactions, sales, and day-to-day operations. The social media giant also unveiled the Meta Business Agent Platform for large enterprises, alongside new business discovery features that enable users to search for businesses directly within WhatsApp.
title: WhatsApp Brings Meta Business Agent to India; Adds New Business Discovery Features

description: Bitcoin hovered near $63,000 on Wednesday as traders assessed mixed ETF flows, technical resistance, and upcoming US inflation data. Analysts said improving long-term indicators support sentiment, but macro uncertainty continues to limit upside momentum.
title: Bitcoin Consolidates Near $63,000 as Investors Await Fresh Cues

description: Skullcandy has launched the Method 360 ANC true wireless earbuds in India in partnership with Bose. The earbuds feature Sound by Bose tuning, hybrid active noise cancellation, Bluetooth 5.3, Google Fast Pair and multipoint connectivity. They offer up to 40 hours of battery life with the charging case and support custom EQ settings through the Skull-iQ app. The Skullcandy Method 360 ANC is available at an introductory price of Rs. 12,499, while its regular retail price is Rs. 16,999.
title: Skullcandy Method 360 ANC With Google Fast Pair, Sound by Bose Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: Meta, the Mark Zuckerberg-led tech giant, has started testing the protorype its new “super sensing” smart glasses, according to a report, citing people with knowledge of the matter. The AI-powered wearables will reportedly be capable of continuously recording audio and images “every few seconds”, dubbed as an “all-seeing” and an “all-hearing” device. Meta’s AI models will then be able to use the images and audio recordings to generate context-based responses against user queries, the report added.
title: Meta's Smart Glasses With ‘Super Sensing’ Capabilities Reportedly Enter Prototype Testing Phase

description: Google Pixel 11 series is expected to launch globally on August 12 at 3 pm PT (3:30 am IST). Soon after the invites surfaced online, the price, storage variants, and colour options of the upcoming Google Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold surfaced online. The leaked prices hint that the handsets will see a significant price hike in the EU and the UK over the Pixel 10 lineup. Moreover, the Mountain View-based tech giant will reportedly not launch a 128GB storage option for the phones.
title: Google Pixel 11 Series Price, Storage Options and Colourways Leaked Ahead of August 12 Debut

description: Samsung has reportedly increased the prices of seven Galaxy smartphone lineups in India, according to a leaked internal document shared by a tipster on X. The revision, which reportedly took effect on July 4, affects select Galaxy A, Galaxy F and Galaxy M series models, with retail prices rising by up to Rs. 1,000 across variants. While the revised prices for some handsets are already visible on the Samsung India website, others had not been updated at the time of writing. Gadgets 360 has contacted Samsung for comment.
title: Samsung to Hike Prices of Seven Galaxy Smartphone Models in India, Tipster Claims

description: Vivo X Fold 6 is said to go official in India in October this year. That's about a few months later than Vivo's usual launch timings. For comparison, the Vivo X Fold 5 was released in July last year, while the Vivo X Fold 3 Pro was released in June 2024.  The Vivo X Fold 6 is tipped to be priced above Rs. 1,05,000 in India. Specification-wise, the Indian variant of the Vivo X Fold 6 is said to be similar to the Chinese variant. It could come with a 7,000mAh battery with 80W wired and 40W wireless charging support.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 India Launch Could Be Much Later Than Usual, Price Range Leaked

description: Mere days after Xbox announced plans to lay off thousands of employees and spin off multiple studios, one of its publishing partners has now confirmed job cuts of its own. IO Interactive, the studio behind the acclaimed Hitman franchise and the new James Bond-starring 007: First Light, declared that it will close its Istanbul studio, while also laying off an unspecified number of employees. As per the video game publisher, the move follows the ending of an external funding partnership for its long-in-development fantasy RPG, Project Fantasy.
title: IO Interactive Announces Istanbul Studio Closure, Layoffs After Xbox Ends Project Fantasy Funding

description: Redmi Note 17 series will be launched in China on July 14 at 7 pm local time (4:30 pm IST), the Xiaomi sub-brand announced on Wednesday. The new smartphone lineup will include at least two models, namely Redmi Note 17 and Redmi Note 17 Pro. Along with the launch date announcement, the company has also revealed the design of the Redmi Note 17 series. Both phones are shown to feature a square-shaped rear camera module, placed in the top-left corner of the flat panel. While one of the handsets is shown to feature a dual camera unit, the other appears with a single shooter on the back. The Redmi Note 17 Pro has also been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform.
title: Redmi Note 17 Series Launch Date Revealed Along With Design, Colour Options

description: Honor Robot Phone could launch in August, according to a Weibo post by a tipster. Honor has already confirmed that the smartphone will go on sale in China during the second half of 2026. The handset features a retractable rear camera module with a 4DoF gimbal and AI-powered tracking. Separate leaks also suggest it could carry a 200-megapixel primary camera. The Robot Phone is expected to debut Honor's imaging partnership with ARRI and support professional video recording features.
title: Honor Robot Phone Launch Timeline Leaked, Tipster Claims Phone Could Debut in August

description: Apple's upcoming iPhone 18 Pro will reportedly retain the aluminium alloy design introduced with the iPhone 17 Pro. The upcoming phone is said to have a noticeably thicker aluminium frame and camera module than its predecessor. The iPhone 18 Pro is expected to launch in September this year alongside the iPhone 18 Pro Max and the foldable iPhone. It could come with a triple rear camera unit and a 2nm A20 chipset.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Said to Have Noticeably Thicker Aluminium Frame Compared to iPhone 17 Pro

description: Google announced its Made by Google event on Tuesday. The annual hardware launch event is expected to introduce the next-generation flagship Pixel lineup, widely referred to as the Pixel 11 series. The event will once again be held in New York City, marking the second consecutive year that Google has chosen the US city as its launch venue. Alongside the smartphones, the Mountain View-based tech giant is also rumoured to unveil the Pixel Watch 5 series.
title: Made by Google Event for Pixel 11 Launch Set for August 12: What to Expect

description: Samsung finally announced the date for its highly anticipated Galaxy Unpacked event on Wednesday. At the bi-annual showcase, the South Korean tech conglomerate is expected to take the wraps off its latest generations of foldable smartphones — the Galaxy Z Fold 8 series and the Galaxy Z Flip 8, with the rumoured wide foldable being the most anticipated model of the lineup. Samsung also teased that the upcoming Galaxy devices will combine "intelligent capabilities" with new form factors, hinting towards an expanded device portfolio.
title: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked 2026 Date Announced; Galaxy Z Fold 8, Flip 8, Watch 9 Series Expected
